pr_body:
Epic: None

Fixes: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/104243

Previously, the mixed version tenant span stats roachtest asserted different errors in different mixed version states. This change simplifies the test, expecting that it always returns some form of error in a mixed-version state.

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/105573)
